title: Stability of Solutions to Semilinear Exterior Dirichlet Problems under Convergence of Lévy Symbols
summary: We study stability of semilinear exterior Dirichlet problems driven by possibly nonsymmetric Levy operators. Let $L^n$ and $L$ have Lévy-Khintchine symbols $ψ_n$ and $ψ$, respectively. Our basic assumption on the operators is that $ψ_n(ξ)\toψ(ξ)$ for every $ξ\in\mathbb R^d$. Under mild regularity assumptions on the domain and an absolute-continuity condition for the resolvent of the limiting process, we prove pointwise and $L^p$-stability of solutions.
